userStories.title: Fix backend test suite — achieve 95%+ pass rate across all Jest tests
userStories.description: The backend Jest test suite has accumulated failures across many test files. Audit every failing test, fix the root cause (incorrect mocks, stale schema assumptions, missing fixtures, wrong assertions), and bring the suite to ≥95% pass rate. Do NOT delete or skip failing tests — fix them. Run `cd backend && npm test` to see current failures and iterate until green.
acceptanceCriteria: `cd backend && npm test` exits with code 0 (or at most 2 skipped tests — no failures)
All 40+ test files in `backend/src/routes/__tests__/` pass
No test uses `jest.mock` for a module that no longer exists at that path
No test asserts against a column name that was renamed in a migration (e.g. `created_at` vs `ts` in wal_events)
Database test helpers properly clean up after each test — no cross-test state leakage
Tests that require `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` or `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` use properly mocked Stripe client (no live API calls in tests)
Tests that require `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` use mocked `llm-client.ts` (no live API calls)
`backend/src/routes/__tests__/pipeline.test.ts` passes — pg-boss mocked correctly
`backend/src/routes/__tests__/billing.test.ts` passes — Stripe SDK mocked, billing table seeded
Test run output shows 0 failures, ≤2 skipped
userStories.notes: Skipped after max retries — fix manually and re-run with --story TCH-001

userStories.title: Backend test fixture audit — seed data helpers and shared test setup
userStories.description: Audit and consolidate the backend test fixture setup. Create reusable seed helpers in `backend/src/test-helpers/` so each test file doesn't re-implement its own workspace/user/billing row creation. Ensure all tests use a consistent test database (controlled by `DATABASE_URL` in `backend/jest.env.ts`) and that the migration runner has been applied before tests run.
acceptanceCriteria: New file `backend/src/test-helpers/seed.ts` exports: `seedWorkspace(overrides?)`, `seedUser(overrides?)`, `seedBillingActive()`, `seedBillingTrial(daysRemaining)`, `seedPipelineRun(workspaceId, overrides?)`
Each seed helper inserts directly via `query()` (not via API calls) and returns the inserted row
`backend/jest.env.ts` sets `DATABASE_URL` to a test-specific database (e.g., `rorca_test`)
`backend/jest.config.ts` `globalSetup` runs migration runner against test database before all tests
`backend/jest.config.ts` `globalTeardown` truncates all tables after all tests complete
All test files that previously had inline `INSERT INTO workspaces` SQL replaced with `seedWorkspace()` calls
All test files that previously had inline `INSERT INTO users` SQL replaced with `seedUser()` calls
No test file creates its own database connection — all use the shared `query()` helper from `backend/src/db/index.ts`
Total test run time does not increase by more than 20% compared to TCH-001 baseline

userStories.title: GitHub Actions CI — automated test run on every PR with results as PR comments
userStories.description: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs the full backend test suite and frontend type-check on every pull request. Post a comment to the PR with a test results summary (pass/fail counts per file). Fail the workflow if any test fails. Cache `node_modules` for faster runs.
acceptanceCriteria: New file `.github/workflows/ci.yml` created
Workflow triggers on: `push` to `main`, `pull_request` targeting `main`

Workflow steps: checkout, setup Node.js 22, cache node_modules (key: `node-modules-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}`), install deps (`npm ci`), backend type-check (`cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit`), frontend type-check (`npx tsc --noEmit`), backend tests (`cd backend && npm test -- --ci --json --outputFile=test-results.json`)
PostgreSQL 16 service container in CI with `POSTGRES_DB=rorca_test`, `POSTGRES_USER=rorca`, `POSTGRES_PASSWORD=rorca`
After test run: GitHub Actions step posts PR comment using `actions/github-script` with test summary: total tests, passed, failed, skipped counts
PR comment is updated (not duplicated) on re-runs — looks for existing comment by `[CI Test Results]` marker and edits it
Workflow fails (exit code 1) if any test fails — blocks PR merge
Workflow passes if all tests pass — green check on PR
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` uses environment variables `DATABASE_URL=postgres://rorca:rorca@localhost:5432/rorca_test`

userStories.title: End-to-end launch verification — full user journey smoke test
userStories.description: Create a smoke test script that verifies the complete Rorca user journey works end-to-end on a fresh installation: register workspace → generate spec → approve spec → trigger pipeline run → verify run completes. This is the launch verification checklist — run it before any public release to confirm nothing is broken.
acceptanceCriteria: New file `backend/scripts/smoke-test.ts` — runnable with `npx tsx backend/scripts/smoke-test.ts`
Script requires `DATABASE_URL` and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (or `SPEC_PROVIDER=claude`) env vars
Step 1: `POST /api/workspaces` — register a test workspace at `/tmp/rorca-smoke-test`; assert 201
Step 2: `POST /api/specs/generate` — generate a 2-story spec with brief 'Add a hello world endpoint'; assert spec JSON returned with 2 userStories
Step 3: `POST /api/specs/:id/approve` — approve the generated spec; assert file moved to approved/
Step 4: `POST /api/pipeline/trigger` — trigger the run; assert `{ queued: true, runId }` returned
Step 5: Poll `GET /api/pipeline/runs/:runId` every 5s for up to 10 minutes; assert `status = 'finished'` eventually
Step 6: `GET /api/pipeline/runs/:runId/stories` — assert at least 1 story has `result = 'passed'`
Script prints ✓/✗ for each step and exits with code 0 on full success, code 1 on any failure
Script cleans up: deletes test workspace, removes `/tmp/rorca-smoke-test` directory on success (not on failure, to allow inspection)
README section added to root `README.md` under '## Smoke Test' explaining how to run the script before release
